captive.jaymoskingdoms.let_go: Untie them and let them go
captive.jaymoskingdoms.hideout: %1$s, last I heard, holed up near %2$s, %3$s
I never meant for anyone to be hurt. Please. Let me put it right.
I know what I did. I'd give it all back if I could. Let me try.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.offer: Let them go, to make amends
captive.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.taken: Thank you. I'll make it right, I swear it. You'll hear from me.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.freed: You're kinder than I've any right to. Thank you.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.cells: I'll take what's coming. I deserve it.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.plea.0: Well! This is a fine way to meet someone. Any chance we could start over?
captive.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.plea.1: You've got me, fair and square. I don't suppose you'd let a friend off?
captive.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.offer: Let them off, and they owe you one
captive.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.taken: Ha! You won't regret it. I'll find you one day, and you'll be glad of the company.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.freed: Now that's the spirit. I'll not forget it.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.cells: Ah well. It was a good run while it lasted.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.plea.0: Let's be sensible. You want coin. So do I. There's more on me than they'll pay you.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.plea.1: Whatever they're paying, I'll pay you more. Name it.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.offer: Take their coin and let them go
captive.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.taken: There. More than they'd give you. Pleasure doing business.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.cells: You could have been rich, you fool.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.brave.plea.0: You beat me. I don't say that often. A fighter like you could use another blade.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.brave.plea.1: Hang me if you like. Or take me on. I'd fight at your side.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.brave.taken: Then I'm yours. Lead and I'll follow.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.brave.refused: No. I'll not serve anyone. Take me in, then. I'll walk.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.brave.freed: I owe you my life. I won't forget it.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.proud.plea.0: You caught me with a rope. Any coward can throw a rope. Fight me fairly.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.proud.plea.1: Tied like an animal. Cut me loose and face me, if you've the stomach.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.proud.offer: Cut them loose and fight them fair
captive.jaymoskingdoms.proud.beaten: Enough. You beat me fair. I'll go in with my head up.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.proud.won: Down in the dirt. Remember who put you there.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.proud.freed: I'd have beaten you, given the chance.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.proud.cells: They'll say I was beaten fairly. That's something.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.devout.plea.0: Before they judge me, let me say it aloud. I need to confess.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.devout.plea.1: I've carried this too long. Will you hear me?
captive.jaymoskingdoms.devout.taken: It was %1$s. I did it, and I'm sorry for it. Take me in. Let the court weigh it.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.devout.freed: Mercy. I hadn't hoped for it. Bless you.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.devout.cells: The court will judge me, and so will higher ones. I'm ready.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.plea.0: You've the right of it. I broke the law. I won't fight you.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.plea.1: There's no need for more rope. I know how this goes.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.taken: I'll come quietly. You have my word.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.freed: This isn't how it's done. But thank you.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.cells: It's only right. I'll answer for it.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.plea.0: Who sent you? Who told you where I'd be? Somebody sold me out.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.plea.1: Nobody knew I was here. Nobody. So who talked?
captive.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.taken: If they've sold me, I'll sell them. Listen: %1$s
captive.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.nothin: I don't know who. I don't know anything any more.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.freed: I'll not trust you either. But I'll go.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.cells: Watch your back. Whoever talked about me will talk about you.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.timid.plea.0: Please don't hurt me. Please. I'll do anything.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.timid.plea.1: I wasn't the worst of them. I swear I wasn't.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.timid.offer: Ask where the rest of their lot hide
captive.jaymoskingdoms.timid.taken: I'll tell you, I'll tell you. %1$s. Please, I told you.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.timid.nothing: I don't know anyone. I was on my own. I swear.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.timid.freed: Thank you. Thank you. I'll never do it again.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.timid.cells: Are they going to hurt me?
captive.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.plea.0: Untie me! Untie me and I'll break every bone you've got!
captive.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.plea.1: You think rope will hold me? I'll be out of this and at your throat!
captive.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.offer: Gag them and pull the knots tight
captive.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.taken: You gag %1$s and pull the knots tight again.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.freed: You'll be sorry you didn't keep me tied.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.plea.0: Go on, then. Take me in. I'll remember your face.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.plea.1: You've no idea what you've done. You will.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.taken: Fine. Fine! I swear. Nothing will come after you. Not from me.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.cursed: Swear? I'll swear. I swear my friends will find you, and they'll take their time.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.freed: Soft. That's what you are. Soft.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.cells: Remember this day. My friends will.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.plea.0: Just end it. What's the point of the cells? End it here.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.plea.1: There's nothing for me. Not in the cells, not out of them.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.offer: Tell them there's more for them yet
captive.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.taken: Maybe. Maybe you're right. I'll come along.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.mood.quiet: I said I'd come quietly, and I will.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.mood.confessed: I've said what I had to say. Take me in.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.mood.told: I've told you all I know. Leave me be.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.mood.sworn: I swore, didn't I? Now leave me alone.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.mood.cursed: Nothing more to say to you. My friends will say it.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.mood.hope: I'll come. Don't make me talk about it.
captive.jaymoskingdoms.mood.duel_won: You beat me fair. Get on with it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.hostage.title: Taken by Outlaws %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.hostage.notice: Paid work, and dangerous. One of ours has been carried off and is held bound. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.hostage.text: Outlaws took %6$s, my %7$s, off the road. They have them tied up at a camp near %4$s, %5$s. Cut them loose, or carry them out if you must, and bring them home to %3$s. Mind the ones guarding them.
work.jaymoskingdoms.hostage.freed.0: You came! I'd given up. Quickly, before they see us.
work.jaymoskingdoms.hostage.freed.1: My hands! I can't feel my hands. Thank you. Get me out of here.
work.jaymoskingdoms.hostage.freed.2: Bless you. Take me home. Please, take me home.
work.jaymoskingdoms.hostage.thanks.0: Home. I'm home. I'll never forget who brought me back.
work.jaymoskingdoms.hostage.thanks.1: I can see the roofs. Thank you, thank you.
work.jaymoskingdoms.hostage.thanks.2: They'll never believe it. Thank you for coming for me.
work.jaymoskingdoms.capture.title: Wanted Alive %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.capture.notice: Paid work. A criminal to be brought back alive, not dead. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.capture.text: %6$s is wanted for %7$s, and the court wants them alive to answer for it. They're camped out near %4$s, %5$s, with whoever they could pay. Bring them back to me tied or beaten down, but breathing. A corpse is no use to anyone.
work.jaymoskingdoms.capture.objective: Bring %7$s back to %4$s alive, tied or downed
work.jaymoskingdoms.capture.brought: That's %1$s, all right. Alive, too. Speak to me and they're handed over.
work.jaymoskingdoms.capture.away: %1$s isn't here. Bring them before me, tied or down.
work.jaymoskingdoms.failed.captive: The one you came to free is dead.
work.jaymoskingdoms.failed.alive: The one you were to bring back alive is dead.
work.jaymoskingdoms.failed.joined: You took them into your service instead.
